subject.title: feat(android): add Wear real-time Talk controls

question: Should OpenClaw ship and maintain a publishable Wear OS companion with continuous Talk and the new public Talk-language contract, and should that work land here or as a follow-up to https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/108997?
rationale: The repository already accepted the credential-free proxy foundation, but publication ownership, permanent watch UX scope, and gateway/provider API expansion are product choices that an external contribution cannot settle through implementation quality alone.

options.title: Split after companion base
options.body: Land one reviewed companion UI base first, then rebase a narrower real-time Talk PR that replaces MessageClient PCM transport with ChannelClient.

options.title: Sponsor the combined PR
options.body: Keep the monolithic branch but require the streaming-transport repair and explicit Android, gateway, and provider-contract approval before merge.

options.title: Pause continuous Talk
options.body: Keep the merged phone proxy while deferring the standalone Wear UI and continuous voice product surface.

recommendation.title: Split after companion base
recommendation.body: Land one reviewed companion UI base first, then rebase a narrower real-time Talk PR that replaces MessageClient PCM transport with ChannelClient.

likelyOwner.reason: The most direct ownership signal is the recently merged Wear phone-proxy foundation and its explicit boundary for later watch UI work.
